snippet.title: Platverse: ABYA's Adventure - Demo Update Trailer | Shoot to Move
snippet.description:
The updated demo for Platverse: ABYA's Adventure is here.

Play as ABYA, a small robot awakened in underground ruins, and follow the guidance of the AI Deus through a post-human world filled with collapsed labs, abandoned factories, and silent power stations.

In this hardcore precision platformer, your floating cannon is not just a weapon. It is your movement tool. Shoot switches, flip platforms, trigger mechanisms, and launch yourself through dangerous stages where every shot, jump, and landing matters.

This demo update includes new story content, adjusted levels, and more challenge stages to test your timing, aim, and route planning.

Try the updated Steam Demo: 
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670430/Platverse_ABYAs_Adventure/

Developed by Pone Games.

#Platverse #ABYA #SteamDemo #IndieGame #Platformer #PrecisionPlatformer #gamedev #platformer #gamedev
